description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomFieldAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions related to custom field management within the HRM system.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: This class contains unit tests for the CustomFieldAPI, verifying its CRUD operations, validation rules, and interactions with service and DAO layers in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a single custom field by ID, ensuring proper data mapping and response normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for 'getOne' API call are correctly defined.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field, including DAO interactions and proper data update handling.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeExtraData
methods.description: Ensures that updating the extraData field triggers the appropriate related data cleanup.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeType
methods.description: Verifies behavior when changing the type of a custom field, especially when the field is in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating a custom field.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of custom fields, including error handling for non-existent records.

methods.name: testDeleteNoInUse
methods.description: Ensures delete operation proceeds only if the custom field is not in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new custom field, verifying DAO interactions and correct response formatting.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating a new custom field.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies fetching multiple custom fields, ensuring correct data normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Ensures validation rules for 'getAll' API endpoint are properly defined.
